subject: Venue confirmation document
text: Would you be able to send me a copy of the venue confirmation document when you have a moment? I would like to make sure the club has the current room assignment and arrival details on file. My concern is that if the printout is out of date, we could lose time looking for the entrance during setup. A PDF would be enough, and I can share it with the others if needed. Please let me know if there is a newer version you meant to circulate.
